root_cause.text: The ath5k driver unconditionally writes to `info->status.rates[ts->ts_final_idx + 1].idx = -1` without checking if that index is within the array bounds (size 4), causing an out-of-bounds write when `ts->ts_final_idx` is 3 (the last valid index).
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message explicitly state that `ts->ts_final_idx` can be 3 on 5212, so accessing index 4 is out-of-bounds for the `ieee80211_tx_rate` array of size `IEEE80211_TX_MAX_RATES` (4). The patch adds a condition `if (ts->ts_final_idx + 1 < IEEE80211_TX_MAX_RATES)` to guard the write.
